title: Redstone Block Movers
description: Have fun with new Redstone Block Movers! Move any block you want! Either suck it or shift it!
body:
Thank you for even vewing this mod! I really spent ages making this. Please enjoy!
10 downloads: update! 

Blocks:
Sucker, 
shifter 

If a sucker recieves a redstone input, it moves any block above, to below! 
If a shifter recieves a redstone input, it moves any block below, to the left!

If a player right clicks a sucker or shifter, they will change: 
Suckers will suck from below to the top, 
shifters will shift from top to left!
